Practised reading numerals 0–9 and matching numerals to groups.
Matched groups to numerals correctly in 3 of 5 attempts without help.
Used counting claps and fingers to identify 4 and 8.
The meaning of zero was discussed; teach-back was not passed, and the mix-up was not confirmed corrected.
end.parentNote: Asha practised matching numerals with groups of objects, claps, and fingers. Aarav used counting to identify 4 and showed 8 as 5 fingers plus 3 more. They mixed up whether zero is a number when nothing is left; this was discussed but not confirmed corrected by the end. At home, show small groups of objects, including an empty group, and ask Aarav to choose and say the matching numeral.
